decision.explanation: Documents d00, d01, d02, and d03 describe Lee Seung-hoon (born 1988) as a speed skater, though d03 contains contradictory text calling him a 'basketball player' which is logically inconsistent with the cited Winter Olympics events and distances; d05 and d06 describe a different person, Lee Seung-hoon (born 1960), as a boxer.
